current.summary: Followed docs/build-order.md rather than re-deriving it. Closed Phase 0 by running all five built screens on a Pixel 9a in both modes - the first time this app has been seen rendered. The palette came back exact; the supply count was ellipsised and is fixed. The run exposed that the app has no identity at all, raised by the user mid-session: stock Flutter icon, white cold-start flash, no mark. Fixed what needed no artwork, made the rest an enforced artifact. Then built Phase 1 in full: seven entry routes plus the auth gate, with the entry rules held as states in core/session.dart. 147 tests.
current.state: Entry flow built and verified on device in both modes; 5 earlier screens confirmed against the canvas; no brand artwork anywhere; no backend; nothing persists
decisions: The auth gate is a sheet on the ROOT navigator, not a route - refusing it must not cost the visitor their place, and a tab's navigator is managed declaratively by go_router
Entry routes sit outside both shells: a flow escapable by tapping a tab is not a gate
The entry rules live in Session as states - OTP unskippable by construction, canBook false on a superseded consent version, lock() no-ops unless the session was active so biometry can only unlock
Consent is captured on the OTP screen, not after it (FR-1.10); the primary stays dead until code + required tick, with a line saying why
BrandLockup holds the lockup slot rather than faking a mark - the canvas says a previously assembled set lost the ripple rings and the blue i
The category tile's off-grid literals are recorded, not tokenised, as navPillBg already is
entryGradient and splashGradient added as palette tokens; splashGradient is identical in both themes on purpose
working: Palette verified pixel-exact on a real device in both modes: dark page #050B0F, card #171F25, nav #11171C. The PAL recovery holds and dark mode renders as specified
The app has a way in: cold start lands on the splash; register to OTP to consent to location to Home works end to end
A visitor reaches home, browse and listing detail with no account; the wall is at the booking action and names the provider
147 tests pass, flutter analyze clean (109 at the start of the session; the '97' in the last two handoffs was already stale)
The cold-start flash is gone, asserted against AppPalette so an Android XML resource cannot drift from a Dart token silently
The supply count wraps instead of ellipsising, guarded by a test that measures in the real IBM Plex face
notWorking: No brand artwork anywhere - stock Flutter launcher icon, no adaptive icon, no splash image, no notification icon, no lockup in-app. Searched the whole user profile; the PNGs are not on this machine
Biometry is not wired to the platform: both unlock buttons call unlock(), no local_auth prompt
Nothing persists - SessionController is in-memory, so /unlock is only reachable by deep link today
No Django backend; screens still read core/demo_data.dart
Most screens still placeholders: booking request/status, ride tracking, rate & review, mode switcher, my categories, inbox, top up, become a provider, KYC, six settings screens
iOS is stock and unverified; it cannot be built on this machine
doNotRepeat: Reading a canvas shadow name as if it were ours - pal.shCard is our shadowRow, pal.shRaise is our shadowCard. The vocabularies invert. I shipped a wrong 'fix' on that misreading before the mapping table in tokens.dart corrected me
Pushing a modal onto a tab's Navigator - go_router re-syncs on pop and removes the page underneath. Dismissing the auth gate took the listing with it. useRootNavigator: true
CrossAxisAlignment.stretch on a Row inside a ListView - unbounded cross-axis constraint, does not lay out. Use IntrinsicHeight; a BoxDecoration border is not an alternative on a rounded rect
Assuming a widget in a Column is full width - a Column centres on the cross axis
Asserting text layout under the default test font - it draws every glyph a full em wide. Load the bundled face with FontLoader
find.text on a Text.rich span - needs find.textContaining(..., findRichText: true)
A PowerShell here-string for git commit -m - it breaks on quotes. Write the message to a file and use git commit -F

Carried: claiming 'retrieved' when meaning 'applied'; merging an old design snapshot with a fresh pull; grepping for backRules/motionSpecs/haptics; splitting the canvas from the repo side; a bare grep -o over a 256 KB HTML file
nextSteps: Phase 2 - booking with the payment moment moved: booking request, booking status (11 states), rate & review. Payment precedes 'mark complete', at position 4. DISPUTED and NO_SHOW stay out, they have no honest copy yet

Phase 0.5 the moment the artwork arrives: export into design/assets/, then launcher icon at all densities, adaptive icon, the Android 12 splash API, notification icon, and swap BrandLockup to the image. Update docs/identity.md and the hashes in identity_test.dart together
Finish Phase 1's two loose ends: local_auth behind the unlock buttons, and persistence for SessionController
Read docs/build-order.md and update it with its test - do not re-derive the order in a handoff
blockers: NEW AND HARD-BLOCKING: the brand artwork. Nothing in Phase 0.5 can proceed without it and it cannot be reconstructed from this repo
Already-accepted bookings on category revoke - still the code blocker for the admin Revoke action
Late-cancellation fee amount - percentage, flat, or first-occurrence waiver
No-show consequence for providers - what happens, and after how many
Commission rate per category - rides shows 8%, trades and rentals unresolved
Dispute turnaround - screens promise contact but name no timeframe
Not yet designed at all: customer-provider messaging, provider listing management at scale, empty/offline states
Wallet naming vs compliance.md - design says 'wallet balance', CLAUDE.md still says 'commission credit'
Carried: reversal policy, negative balance, min top-up, hosting durability, EPS licensing, data residency, KYC retention, GPS DPIA
